narrative:
Adams County has 17,076 registered voters, with 51.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 38.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 9.5%, a pronounced Republican lean of 29.4 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.6% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean -20.8% D−R vs -33.0% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
